cards.title: A run today
cards.text: What happens from entering a dungeon to the boss, in six parts. Mark any part that's off.
cards.why: The questions after this one change pieces of it.

parts.title: Layout
parts.text: 3 floors of 3 rooms. The last room of floor 3 is the Bone King with a few skeletons.

parts.title: Rooms
parts.text: Every room is the same open rectangle: in on the left, out on the right, 0 to 3 pillars.

parts.title: Room types
parts.text: Pack (enemies only), hazard (2 to 4 oil or spike patches), treasure (a chest), mixed, and the boss room.

parts.title: Keys and chests
parts.text: Sometimes an enemy carries a key. After the fight the nearest hero walks to the chest and opens it, and a trinket goes in the satchel.

parts.title: Between rooms
parts.text: HP carries over. Downed heroes stay down until the floor is beaten, then come back at 10% HP. No healing except levelling up.

parts.title: Your input
parts.text: Speed (1x, 2x, 4x) and Retreat. Nothing else during a run.

cards.title: Room shapes
cards.text: Every room is the same rectangle. Should rooms come in different shapes?
cards.why: Shapes change how fights go: a corridor lets the knight hold a line, and a wall with gaps gives the archer cover. Today every fight looks alike after a few runs.
cards.pick: Yes: a handful of hand-made shapes (L-room, corridor, split room, round arena), with hazards and pillars still placed at random.
cards.details: This needs the heroes to find their way around walls, which they can't do yet: see [Pathfinding](riffle:delve/brains/pathfinding).

cards.title: Choosing the next room
cards.text: Should you get to choose between doors on the way out of a room?
cards.why: It's the one input that fits a game you mostly watch: a choice every minute or so, never during a fight.
cards.pick: Yes: two doors with icons (fight, treasure, rest, ?). Tap one, or the party picks by itself after 5 seconds.
cards.details: The ? door would be where Easter eggs and odd rooms live.

cards.title: Healing during a run
cards.text: The only healing in a run is levelling up. Should there be more?
cards.why: By floor 3 the party is often worn down by small hits, so the boss fight depends more on earlier luck than on the boss.
cards.pick: A rest room on each floor (a fountain that heals everyone 40%), and nothing else, so it stays a big deal.

cards.title: Easter eggs
cards.text: The five Easter eggs we talked about. Mark the ones you want, and say which goes in first.
cards.why: Each is small to build, and they make you want to watch closely.
cards.pick: The cracked wall first, since explosions already exist. Then the mimic chest.

parts.title: Mimic chest
parts.text: Now and then a chest bites back. Beating it gives two trinkets.

parts.title: Cracked wall
parts.text: A crack in a room's wall. An explosion next to it opens a secret room with gold.

parts.title: The duck
parts.text: A duck in a room. If no one hits it, it follows the party out and stays for the run.

parts.title: Nothing personal
parts.text: Rarely, a rogue backstab crit says "nothing personal".

parts.title: Sleeping boss
parts.text: If the rogue walks in first, the boss stays asleep for a free opening hit.

cards.title: More than one boss
cards.text: Every depth ends with the same Bone King. Should there be others?
cards.why: The boss is the moment every run builds to, and seeing the same one each time makes deeper runs feel the same.
cards.pick: One new boss per few depths, each built around a status: a slime queen (wet), a rat king (bleed), and the Bone King stays.

cards.title: Sound
cards.text: There's no sound yet. Add some?
cards.why: Hits, freezes and explosions land much harder with a sound. On the phone it follows the silent switch.
cards.pick: Yes, small sounds made in code (no sound files, so it stays light offline), with a mute button at camp.
